title: SAMPLE: Intermittent internet reported in Murzuq
summary: A sample connectivity note described intermittent service in Murzuq. There is no measurement feed behind this item.
whatHappened: A sample civil-society note said home broadband in Murzuq dropped repeatedly on 31 August and 1 September 2026. Mobile data was described as slow rather than absent.
whyItMatters: Southern connectivity gaps affect reporting, banking applications and humanitarian coordination. Intermittent service is not evidence of a complete cut.
watchNext: Whether disruption continues into the sample week, and whether any operator acknowledges an incident.
confidenceRationale: Single uncorroborated local note; no network telemetry.
